definitions.explanation: A space entirely devoid of matter, or a space with greatly reduced air pressure.

examples.japanese: {宇宙|うちゅう}は{真空|しんくう}の{状態|じょうたい}だ。
examples.english: Space is in a vacuum state.

examples.japanese: {真空|しんくう}パックで{食品|しょくひん}を{保存|ほぞん}する。
examples.english: I preserve food in vacuum packs.
examples.notes: 真空パック is a common compound

examples.japanese: {真空|しんくう}{状態|じょうたい}では{音|おと}が{伝|つた}わらない。
examples.english: Sound doesn't travel in a vacuum.

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{真空|しんくう}パック (vacuum pack/packaging)
・{真空|しんくう}{管|かん} (vacuum tube)
・{真空|しんくう}{掃除機|そうじき} (vacuum cleaner) - though this is different from scientific vacuum
・{真空|しんくう}{状態|じょうたい} (vacuum state/condition)

SCIENTIFIC NOTE:
In physics, a "perfect vacuum" is theoretical. In everyday use, {真空|しんくう} often refers to low-pressure environments or vacuum packaging for food preservation.

[Register: Neutral to Technical]
